ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 97% of the visible surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to micro-speckling and distal tip regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-frequency, low-diameter white focal spots are distributed across the proximal regions of both lobes; a higher density of contiguous white pixels is mapped to the extreme lateral margins (distal tips).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular serrations with three distinct macro-valleys; the left lobe displays a smoother, lower-amplitude topography with high-frequency micro-variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the distal tips toward the median notch, characterized by irregular non-linear segments along the trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles/scars) are localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes; the right tip contains a cluster of approximately 6-8 individual rosettes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular notches and indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, appearing as semi-circular removals of tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetric localization of parasitic/epibiotic colonization restricted almost exclusively to the distal-most points of the trailing edge.
